name: Minecraft Java Edition
tagline: Your own Minecraft server for Java Edition players.
description: Runs a Minecraft Java Edition server for you and your friends, using the itzg image: vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge and more, with the game downloaded and kept up to date at start.
postInstall: The first start downloads Minecraft and builds the world: follow it in Logs, it takes a minute or two.
In Minecraft, choose Multiplayer, Add Server, and enter this server's address with the game port (25565 by default).
To play from outside your home, forward the game port on your router.
TYPE picks the server (VANILLA, PAPER, FABRIC, FORGE...) and VERSION a Minecraft release; change them in Apps, Edit, then restart.

env.prompt: Type TRUE to accept the Minecraft EULA (minecraft.net/eula)
Message shown in the server list
Operators: player names, separated by commas
